      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\mod.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 43
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! plan mode implementation",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides read-only planning phase with approval gates, budget enforcement,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! and multiple execution strategies (single, orchestrated, competition).",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module extends the official Plan Mode collaboration template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;) with advanced features",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! while maintaining alignment with the official 2-phase conversational approach.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Structure",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode (improved in commits #9877, #9874) uses a conversational",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 1. **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Understand what the user actually wants",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Key preferences/tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Bias toward questions over guessing",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2. **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Technical spec and implementation plan",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Rollout/monitoring, migrations/compat constraints",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Key Principles from Official Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Questions must materially change the spec/plan,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   confirm/lock assumptions, or choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Two kinds of unknowns**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   1. Discoverable facts: Explore first (≥2 targeted searches) before asking",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   2. Preferences/tradeoffs: Ask early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Finalization rule**: Only output final plan when remaining unknowns are low-impact",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   and explicitly listed as assumptions",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module adds advanced capabilities beyond the official template:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets with per-step and session caps",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed event-based logs of plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.30555200576782227
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\manager.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40,
            "column": 39
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan manager",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! High-level API for creating, updating, approving, and exporting plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module works in conjunction with the official Plan Mode collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! template (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;). The official template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! provides the conversational prompt structure for LLM interactions, while this module",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! manages the structured &#96;PlanBlock&#96; data that results from those interactions.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Improvements (commits #9877, #9874)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode follows a 2-phase conversational approach:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Gather goal, success criteria, audience, scope, constraints,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! current state, and key preferences/tradeoffs. Bias toward questions over guessing.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Once intent is stable, gather decision-complete spec:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! approach, interfaces, data flow, edge cases, testing criteria, rollout/monitoring.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Key principles:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask many questions, but only those that materially change the spec/plan",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Batch questions (4-10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Explore discoverable facts first before asking",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask preferences/tradeoffs early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module extends the official Plan Mode with advanced features:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets per step and session",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed logs of plan execution with events",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Orchestration**: Support for single, orchestrated, and competition execution modes",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Research integration**: Deep research capabilities for plan creation",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Quality assurance**: QC analysis and quality gates",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **State management**: Drafting, approval, execution, and completion states",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::persist::PlanPersister;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::ApprovalRole;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PolicyEnforcer;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PrivilegedOperation;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.26423144340515137
    },

独自機能モジュール（orchestration, agents, plan, qc等）\n- &#96;codex-cli&#96; - CLI実行ファイル\n- &#96;codex-tui&#96; - TUI（Personality機能含む）\n- その他ワークスペースメンバー\n\n### Step 2: テスト実行\n\n**目的**: 既存テストが正常に動作することを確認\n\n**実行コマンド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo test --workspace --features custom-features\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**確認項目**:\n- 全テストが通過すること\n- 失敗したテストがあれば原因を記録\n- テスト実行時間の記録\n\n**重点確認**:\n- Personality機能のテスト（&#96;codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/tests.rs&#96;）\n- Plan機能のテスト（&#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96;）\n- 独自機能のテスト（orchestration, agents, qc等）\n\n### Step 3: リンター実行\n\n**目的**: コード品質と警告の確認\n\n**実行コマンド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo clippy --workspace --features custom-features -- -D warnings\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**確認項目**:\n- クリッピー警告がないこと（&#96;-D warnings&#96;で警告をエラーとして扱う）\n- 修正が必要な警告があれば記録\n\n### Step 4: フォーマットチェック\n\n**目的**: コードフォーマットの統一確認\n\n**実行コマンド**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo fmt --all -- --check\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**確認項目**:\n- フォーマット違反がないこと\n- 違反があれば自動修正可能（&#96;--check&#96;を外して実行）\n\n### Step 5: 独自機能の動作確認\n\n**目的**: 統合後も独自機能が正常に動作することを確認\n\n**確認項目**:\n\n1. **Personality機能**:\n   - Orchestration機能\n   - Agents機能\n   - QC機能\n   - Git4D機能\n   - VR/AR統合機能\n\n**確認方法**:\n- 手動テスト（TUI起動してコマンド実行）\n- 既存の統合テスト実行\n\n### Step 6: 実装ログ作成\n\n**目的**: 実装完了を記録し、今後の参照用に保存\n\n**保存先**: &#96;_docs/2026-01-26_公式機能統合とupstream_mainマージ完了{main}.md&#96;\n\n**記録内容**:\n- 実施日時\n- 完了したフェーズのサマリー\n- ビルド・テスト結果\n- 検証結果\n- 残課題（あれば）\n- 保護された独自機能の確認\n\n## 保護対象の確認\n\n以下のモジュールが&#96;#[cfg(feature = \"custom-features\")]&#96;で保護されていることを確認：\n\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/qc/&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/cowork_integration.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/vr_ar_integration.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/git4d_accelerated.rs&#96;\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/superior_git4d_visualizer.rs&#96;\n\n## リスクと対策\n\n1. **ビルドエラー**\n   -             "text": "Each response yields:",

          },
          {
            "text": "Fetch the built-in collaboration mode presets with &#96;collaborationMode/list&#96;. This endpoint does not accept pagination and returns the full list in one response:",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;data&#96; – ordered list of collaboration mode masks (partial settings to apply on top of the base mode)",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "  - For tri-state fields like &#96;reasoning_effort&#96; and &#96;developer_instructions&#96;, omit the field to keep the current value, set it to &#96;null&#96; to clear it, or set a concrete value to update it.",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "## Event stream",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "While a conversation runs, the server sends notifications:",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex/event&#96; with the serialized Codex event payload. The shape matches &#96;core/src/protocol.rs&#96;’s &#96;Event&#96; and &#96;EventMsg&#96; types. Some notifications include a &#96;_meta.requestId&#96; to correlate with the originating request.",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "- Auth notifications via method names &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96; and &#96;authStatusChange&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "Clients should render events and, when present, surface approval requests (see next section).",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tool responses",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;codex&#96; and &#96;codex-reply&#96; tools return standard MCP &#96;CallToolResult&#96; payloads. For",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "compatibility with MCP clients that prefer &#96;structuredContent&#96;, Codex mirrors the",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "content blocks inside &#96;structuredContent&#96; alongside the &#96;threadId&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "Example:",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"content\": [{ \"type\": \"text\", \"text\": \"Hello from Codex\" }],",
            "lineNumber": 127
          }
        ]
      },

          {
            "text": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "This document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "At a glance:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- Conversations",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;",

          },

          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
